tasks.label: Build Pico 2 W (Debug)
tasks.command: export PATH=/home/tcmichals/.tools/gcc-arm-none-eabi/bin:$PATH && export PICO_SDK_PATH=/home/tcmichals/.tools/pico-sdk && cmake -B build_pico2w_debug -DPICO_BOARD=pico2_w -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build_pico2w_debug -j$(nproc)

tasks.label: Build Pico 2 W (Release)
tasks.command: export PATH=/home/tcmichals/.tools/gcc-arm-none-eabi/bin:$PATH && export PICO_SDK_PATH=/home/tcmichals/.tools/pico-sdk && cmake -B build_pico2w -DPICO_BOARD=pico2_w -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build_pico2w -j$(nproc)
